summary_rule: verdict per metric: 'unchanged' if V3 equals V2 exactly; 'not meaningfully changed' if |V3 - V2| < min(0.05 * |V2|, one weekend's worth), where one weekend's worth is 1 for a count over the weekends benchmarked, |V2| / n for a mean over n weekends, and undefined (5% alone) for a single figure; otherwise 'improved' or 'regressed' by direction. Lower is better for MAE, absolute bias, interval width, first-stop error, oracle regret, stop-call error, tick latency, runtime, memory and failing gates; higher is better for match counts, field shares, coverage-in-band, precision and recall. A coverage metric is judged by its distance to its target band (90%: 0.88-0.93, 95%: 0.93-0.97), not by being larger. 'unavailable' means one of the three builds does not report the metric.

deg_mae_mean.label: Degradation-rate error vs the race (stint-rate MAE, s/lap, mean over weekends)

deg_bias_mean.label: Stint-rate bias (s/lap, mean over weekends; 0 is best)

cov90.label: 90% interval coverage on the stint rate

cov95.label: 95% interval coverage on the stint rate
cov95.note: computed here from the per-stint tables of all three builds' posteriors; the frozen V1/V2 runs did not report it themselves

width.label: 90% interval width on the stint rate (s/lap)

practice_only_mae.label: Practice posterior x regime, no circuit history (stint-rate MAE)

mixedlm_mae.label: MixedLM slope x regime (the frequentist baseline)

sequence_run_by_anyone.label: Compound sequence run by at least one finisher

mean_field_share.label: Mean share of the field that ran the recommended sequence

first_stop_abs_err.label: Mean |first stop − field green-flag median| (laps, non-SC weekends)

first_stop_bias.label: Mean signed first stop − field median (laps, non-SC weekends)

first_stop_abs_err_tyre_optimal.label: Same, the tyre-optimal plan (no prior, no position term)

first_stop_abs_err_v3_no_prior.label: Same, V3 with the first-stop prior switched off (kappa = 0)
first_stop_abs_err_v3_no_prior.note: the V2 column is V2's shipped answer, the closest published equivalent

first_stops_inside_window.label: Share of the field's first stops inside the model's window

oracle_regret_tool.label: Oracle regret of the tool's plan (s, true race rates, same cost structure)
oracle_regret_tool.note: all three plans priced on this run's oracle, so the comparison is like for like

oracle_regret_field.label: Oracle regret of the field's modal plan (s)
oracle_regret_field.note: each build prices the field's plan on its own oracle (the oracle inherits that build's pace offsets), so this row says how hard the race was, not how good the tool is

oracle_regret_winner.label: Oracle regret of the winner's plan (s)
oracle_regret_winner.note: as above: a property of the race and of the build's oracle, not of the recommendation

oracle_beats_field.label: Weekends where the tool's plan beats the field's modal plan on the oracle
oracle_beats_field.note: all three plans priced on this run's single oracle

tyre_life_overstatements.label: Compound-weekends where predicted life exceeds the longest stint run (of 20)

tyre_life_understatements.label: Compound-weekends where it is shorter than the longest stint run (of 20)
tyre_life_understatements.note: an under-statement is a different failure from an over-statement, not its mirror

tyre_life_median_ratio.label: Median predicted life ÷ longest stint run (1.0 is honest)

percar_same_shape_share.label: Share of cars whose own plan shares the field plan's shape
percar_same_shape_share.note: informative about the field, not about the car: a high share means the per-car terms moved little

percar_first_stop_spread.label: Per-car first-stop spread within a weekend (laps)
percar_first_stop_spread.note: wider is only better if it is right; see the Spearman rows

percar_spearman_hist.label: Spearman, predicted vs observed stint rate — per-car scale: LOO race factors (V2's per-car term)
percar_spearman_hist.note: V2's column is its own `sealed_driver` variant, the only per-car scale it had

percar_spearman_practice_dev.label: Spearman, predicted vs observed stint rate — per-car scale: this weekend's own dev[d,c]
percar_spearman_practice_dev.note: V2's column is its own `sealed_driver` variant, the only per-car scale it had

percar_spearman_team_pooled.label: Spearman, predicted vs observed stint rate — per-car scale: team-pooled dev (V3 ships this)
percar_spearman_team_pooled.note: V2's column is its own `sealed_driver` variant, the only per-car scale it had

stint_rank_spearman.label: Spearman, predicted vs observed stint rate (field model)

collapse_pred_abs_err_laps.label: Predicted collapse lap (budget ÷ rate) vs the detected knee (laps)
collapse_pred_abs_err_laps.note: V3 only: V1 and V2 had no within-stint collapse detector

collapse_n_detected.label: Stints the detector calls a pace collapse

bayes_vs_stint_fe_slope_gap.label: |Bayes pooled slope − stint-FE baseline| (s/lap; the V3 gate, ≤ 0.06)
bayes_vs_stint_fe_slope_gap.note: V3 only: it replaces V2's MixedLM range gate, which failed at three low-degradation circuits

live_tick_mean_ms.label: Live engine tick, whole field (ms, mean over the replays)

live_stops_in_window.label: Share of real stops inside the engine's window 3 laps earlier

live_stops_within_3_laps.label: Share of real stops within 3 laps of the recommendation

live_box_now_cost_s.label: 'Box now' cost the lap before the real stop (s, median)

live_window_precision.label: Live signal precision: window (a stop within 3 laps = true positive)
live_window_precision.note: V3 only: V1 and V2 reported no precision for any signal

live_box_now_precision.label: Live signal precision: box_now (a stop within 3 laps = true positive)
live_box_now_precision.note: V3 only: V1 and V2 reported no precision for any signal

live_collapse_precision.label: Live signal precision: collapse (a stop within 3 laps = true positive)
live_collapse_precision.note: V3 only: V1 and V2 reported no precision for any signal

live_collapse_recall.label: Live signal recall: collapse
live_collapse_recall.note: V2's number is its 'alarm preceded the stop' share, the only recall it reported

outlook_modal_match.label: Prior-only outlook matching the field's modal sequence

outlook_modal_match_letters.label: Same, with the plan prior read letter-for-letter (no C-number mapping)
outlook_modal_match_letters.note: the V2 behaviour, reproduced inside the V3 run as `prior_only_letters`

outlook_mean_seq_share.label: Prior-only outlook: mean share of the field on its plan

search_time_s.label: Strategy search, 500 draws, 1-lap grid, full objective (s)

peak_memory_mb.label: Peak resident memory of the speed benchmark (MB)

gates_failing.label: Gates failing across the benchmarked weekends
